sec: sec:F002: Prevent catastrophic misuse / Control mays

blocks.id: blk:F002: Prevent catastrophic misuse / Control mays/1
blocks.text: Establishing catastrophic misuse monitoring. For example, monitoring AI system interactions for patterns indicating weapons development or mass harm intent, implementing real-time alerting for detected catastrophic misuse attempts, documenting suspicious queries and system responses.
